rights.no_copy_boundary: Do not reproduce source dialogue, branded layout, fictional character, distinctive shot order, music, unverified case study or private information

segments.spoken_text: A tool demo is a reason to test, not switch.
Suppose your repeated task is turning weekly notes into an update. Keep one fictional input ready.
Run that same input through a candidate tool using the same instructions and required output.
Check three things: did it preserve the facts, show missing information, and leave an editable draft?
Record the result beside the tool version and the date. Include the part that failed.
A polished answer is not the whole test. Someone still has to review and maintain the workflow.
If it misses a requirement, adjust the task or reject this candidate. You do not need to switch.
Keep one example and one checklist. Use them for your next tool evaluation.

selection_basis: Clear audience task and production simplicity; no empirical winner claim
